name: Rytr
tagline: Budget AI writing assistant with 40+ templates and tone matching.
description: Rytr generates short-form content across 40+ use cases like emails, ad copy, and social captions, and can mirror a sample of your writing to match tone. It includes grammar checking, plagiarism checks, and a Chrome extension, positioned as a low-cost entry point to AI copywriting.
insight: Acquired by Copysmith in October 2022, roughly 18 months after launch, with over 2 million users.

modelSupport.notes: Uses third-party LLMs under the hood; specific models not published on the site.

edge: Competes on price — an entry paid tier well under most rivals — trading depth for inexpensive unlimited generation.
